adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the new `addMembers` action explicitly notes `// TODO: should clear the input` and simply calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` without clearing `usernames` or handling the returned promise. So the input value will remain and clicking Add again will re-send the same usernames. The diff does not show any UI-side success/error feedback for this action either. This is a concrete, diff-grounded UX/state-management gap rather than a clearly broken correctness bug (server-side may be idempotent).
